image-alt.title: An image needs a description
image-alt.why: People using screen readers may miss what the image communicates.
image-alt.suggestion: Add meaningful alternative text, or empty alt text for a purely decorative image.

button-name.title: A button needs a clear name
button-name.why: A screen reader may announce only “button” without explaining its action.
button-name.suggestion: Give the button an accessible name that describes its action.

link-name.title: A link needs a readable name
link-name.why: People using screen readers need to know where a link leads.
link-name.suggestion: Add meaningful link text or an accessible name.

color-contrast.title: Some text is hard to read
color-contrast.why: Similar text and background colors can make reading difficult for people with low vision.
color-contrast.suggestion: Increase the contrast between the text and its background.

label.title: An input needs a label
label.why: People need to know what information to enter in a form.
label.suggestion: Connect a descriptive label to the input; a placeholder alone is not enough.

html-has-lang.title: The page language is missing
html-has-lang.why: Screen readers need the page language to pronounce words correctly.
html-has-lang.suggestion: Set the correct lang attribute on the html element.

html-lang-valid.title: The page language setting is invalid
html-lang-valid.why: An invalid language code can prevent correct screen reader pronunciation.
html-lang-valid.suggestion: Use a valid language tag that matches the page content.

document-title.title: The page needs a useful title
document-title.why: A page title helps people identify browser tabs and navigate with assistive technology.
document-title.suggestion: Add a descriptive title for this page.

heading-order.title: Headings skip a level
heading-order.why: A clear heading hierarchy helps readers understand the structure of the page.
heading-order.suggestion: Organize heading levels to reflect the sections and subsections.

select-name.title: A dropdown needs a label
select-name.why: Screen reader users need to know what they are choosing.
select-name.suggestion: Give the select control a connected label or accessible name.

frame-title.title: Embedded content needs a name
frame-title.why: Screen reader users need to identify what an embedded frame contains.
frame-title.suggestion: Give the iframe a descriptive title.

aria-hidden-focus.title: A hidden element can still receive keyboard focus
aria-hidden-focus.why: Keyboard users may reach a control that assistive technology cannot describe.
aria-hidden-focus.suggestion: Keep interactive controls out of hidden content, or make the relevant content accessible.
